profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Walmart Global Tech
profile.summary: Software engineer working in large scale development. Experienced in design and building backend services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Platform Automation: Developed and implemented the automation of the Seller Program Eligibility platform, streamlining the qualification process for numerous seller programs within Walmart e-commerce.

- End-to-End Data Pipeline: Implemented robust end-to-end data pipelines, ensuring seamless and high-integrity data flow across the entire system.

- Technical Ownership: Demonstrated strong technical leadership by driving key project workstreams, overseeing system execution, and collaborating across teams to ensure successful delivery.

- Tech Stack: Java Spring Boot, Kafka, SQL, Azure

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
• Walmart Remote Fulfillment: Designed and operated production-grade backend systems for the program and its platform focusing on scalability, reliability, and observability using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and SQL.

• WFS International: Led the design and deployment of Inbound Inventory Allocation systems for Mexico and Canada; served as technical lead for WFS Chile rollout.

• Developed and maintained partner-facing APIs to support seller onboarding and inventory workflows, enabling international e-commerce expansion.

• Implemented a high-availability seller eligibility automation service, reducing manual errors and improving operational throughput.

• Led production readiness efforts through proactive monitoring (Splunk/ OpenObserve), real-time alerting (Prometheus), root cause analysis, and incident mitigation across distributed fulfillment infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- React UI developer in Ion Team building Ion-suite platform. Focusing on implementing new features and improve performances of the application. Designing the development process, participating in system architecture, and code reviews for peers.  

- Build/ Update Ion-suite application provides a fleet telematics solution to the customers with large amounts of vehicles. The services include tracking/ operation history/ diagnostic data / cargo status of vehicles.

- Utilizing ArcGIS Javascript API to create maps and graphics in corresponding to the data from the services. Providing live tracking/ historical fleet data on the map.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Built scalable front-end applications using React and Angular, collaborating with backend teams on Java Spring Boot integration.

• Delivered Angular+NgRX UI for Iberdrola DOMA, deployed via Kubernetes with CI/CD pipelines.

positions.title: Senior PV system designer
positions.description: • Designed residential photovoltaic systems; automated Salesforce CRM and reporting workflows through scripting.

positions.title: PV Designer
positions.description: Provide Engineering/ Design of PV system.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description: Providing a structural designing and consulting service for developers. Mainly focused on residential wood framing and landscape structures. Preparing plan check responses to the city in coordination with the architect and other vendors.
